claim: Annex15, Section72 lists annual fixed delivery-vehicle taxes: motorcycle/motorized tricycle PHP240; delivery jeepney/similar utility vehicle PHP600; truck, van, or any vehicle with six wheels and above PHP1,000; water vessel, barges, ferry boats, tugboats and similar watercraft PHP2,000; airplane/aircraft PHP5,000. The section applies to vehicles used by manufacturers, producers, wholesalers, dealers or retailers in delivery/distribution of the listed products and goods within the City. Preserve the six-wheel row wording when classifying a vehicle.

delivery vehicle, truck, van, or any motor vehicle, vessels or watercraft used by 
manufacturers, producers, wholesalers, dealers or retailers in the delivery or distribution 
of distilled spirits, fermented liquors, soft drinks, cigars and cigarettes and other essential 
products and sales of goods as may hereinafter be determined by the Sangguniang
